title: Report Submission
description: A citizen report of an experience with a government service in India. This schema mirrors the report submission validation in packages/validation/src/report.ts. At least one experience field must be provided: the free-text description and/or one or more of official_fee_reported_inr, additional_amount_reported_inr, amount_paid_inr, paid, delay_days, or visits. JSON Schema cannot express this exclusivity cleanly (an XOR-style requirement), so it is enforced by the API validation layer rather than by this schema; a submission that omits all experience fields is rejected by the API with a 400. Period_end must be greater than or equal to period_start (also enforced by the API). Field semantics follow the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md); the machine-readable form of this schema is served alongside the public dataset and is referenced by the OpenAPI specification at /doc/openapi.json.

service_id.description: UUID of the government service (services.id) the report is about. See the service_slug column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.2).

state_id.description: UUID of the state where the experience happened (states.id). See the state_code and state_name columns in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, sections 6.5-6.6).

district_id.description: UUID of the district where the experience happened (districts.id). See the district_name column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.7).

office_id.description: Optional UUID of the specific office involved (offices.id). Office identifiers are internal reference data and are never exported in any dataset or API response; see docs/privacy.md.

period_start.description: Start of the period the report covers, as YYYY-MM-DD. See the period_start column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.8).

period_end.description: End of the period the report covers, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must be greater than or equal to period_start, enforced by the API validation layer. See the period_end column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.9).

official_fee_reported_inr.description: The official fee for the service as reported by the citizen, in INR. Money is stored as numeric(12,2) and never as a float. See the official_fee_reported_inr column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.10).

additional_amount_reported_inr.description: The additional (unofficial) amount the citizen reports being asked to pay, in INR. A key input to the median-extra-payment aggregate. See the additional_amount_reported_inr column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.11).

amount_paid_inr.description: The total amount the citizen reports actually paying for the service, in INR. Expected to be absent or null when paid is false. See the amount_paid_inr column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.12).

paid.description: Whether the citizen reports paying anything (of any kind) for the service. A reported fact, not a verdict. See the paid column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.13).

delay_days.description: The number of days the citizen reports the service taking beyond the official timeline. A key input to the median-delay aggregate. See the delay_days column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.14).

visits.description: The number of office visits the citizen reports making for the service. An input to the average-visits aggregate. See the visits column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.15).

description.description: Free-text description of the experience, 30 to 5000 characters. Personal identifiers (Aadhaar, mobile numbers, emails, card numbers) are deterministically replaced with [REDACTED] before any public exposure or export; the exported form is the redacted_description column in the data dictionary (docs/data-dictionary.md, section 6.16).
